decisions.reason: Transactional email is shown on the home page and fits squarely with the firm's announced multichannel cloud messaging direction, so its visible commitment and centrality make dropping it very unlikely.
Managed capture has its own page, a documented customer reference, and fits the firm's push toward digital document workflows, so the firm is strongly committed to it.

Email-to-fax conversion builds on the firm's core fax and email infrastructure at low marginal cost and still serves regulated customers, so continuing it is easy to justify despite fax's long-term decline.
The fax delivery optimization feature is tightly bundled with the established fax service and cheap to keep, though as a minor feature it could quietly be folded into the core offer.

Sandbox threat protection is central to the firm's email security portfolio and to its innovation claims, and the earlier withdrawal of multi-engine scanning suggests the firm consolidated its security effort around offerings like this one.
